name: project-context-memory
description: Portable project context memory for continuing work across Codex conversations and model providers.

interface.shortDescription: Keep project understanding portable across conversations.
interface.longDescription: Maintains an evidence-based Markdown context file with project scope, architecture, decisions, constraints, verification, and the next handoff so another Codex conversation or model can continue reliably.
interface.defaultPrompt: Update the project's canonical context and prepare a handoff for the next conversation.
